verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring runs, such as periodic drift detection or plans, is a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code tool, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a built-in scheduler, cron-style triggers, or recurring workflow execution in OpenTofu. The pack covers only on-demand CLI commands (plan, apply, test, import), and any scheduling would have to come from external CI or cron tooling, which earns no credit.
